title: HbA1c Measurement Protocol
author: Peter Havel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ynrfvd6
materials: Mix R1a and R1b reagents together in a 70:30 ratio.

steps.title: Lyse blood samples and calibrators
steps.instruction: Lyse 20 µl samples of whole blood and calibrators using 250 µl of lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Ensure samples are totally lysed to prevent solid material from interfering with the plate reader.

steps.title: Load samples and calibrators
steps.instruction: Add 25 µl of each calibrator and sample to each well.

steps.title: Perform first incubation and reading
steps.instruction: Add 160 µl of reagent R1ab mix to each well and incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Avoid adding bubbles to the wells during reagent dispensing to prevent reading interference.

steps.title: Perform second incubation and reading
steps.instruction: Add 70 µl of R2 to each well and incubate at 37°C for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Calculate HbA1c concentrations
steps.instruction: Subtract blank readings from final readings and calculate unknown samples using the linear assay formula.

substeps.instruction: Calculate as: (Sample Absorbance ÷ Calibrator Absorbance) × Calibrator Concentration.
